meta.title: A bid on a withdrawn event cannot be rejected
gaps: No operation or library case expresses rejecting a vendor bid after the event is withdrawn; the expected refusal is therefore not executable.
warnings: error code 101 is not in en-IN.yml (or the backend checkout is missing) — the message cannot be checked

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer withdraws the event with the remarks set to “QA_Platform_withdraw_…”, with the status set to “withdrawn”.
As the buyer, read the event and check that “status” equals withdrawn.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: “status” equals withdrawn.
